# Duetto for Spec Kit

Runs each Spec Kit phase with **both Claude and Codex**: independent research and plans, rebuttals, adversarial
challenge, and implementation where one model writes and the other reviews. Install the duetto plugin (it carries the
engine) and this extension:

```sh
claude plugin marketplace add bishoyngendy/duetto && claude plugin install duetto@duetto   # or the Codex plugin
git clone https://github.com/bishoyngendy/duetto && specify extension add --dev duetto/speckit/duetto
```

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/speckit-duetto-specify` | Start a feature: Claude and Codex research the codebase independently, then a spec draft is written in Spec Kit's format. |
| `/speckit-duetto-clarify` | Claude and Codex each question the spec draft; you answer the merged questions and the spec is revised with your answers. |
| `/speckit-duetto-plan` | Claude and Codex write independent plans, rebut each other's, the plans are merged (real disagreements come to you), then both attack the merged plan. |
| `/speckit-duetto-tasks` | Break the plan into a Spec Kit tasks.md; tasks marked [P] are independent and will be implemented concurrently. |
| `/speckit-duetto-analyze` | Claude and Codex each audit spec, plan and tasks for gaps, ambiguity, coverage and constitution conflicts before any code is written. |
| `/speckit-duetto-implement` | Implement every task: one model implements, the project's checks run, the other model reviews, until approved; tasks alternate between Claude and Codex. |
| `/speckit-duetto-converge` | Audit the whole feature against its spec; unmet criteria become fix tasks (with your go-ahead), then a report is written. |
